title: NETSAFA International Training Center Support
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVSUP > NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT > NAVSUP FLC NORFOLK > NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR NORFOLK
description: Amendment 2 posted 11/19/2026. Amendment 1 released on 11/4/2026 for Volume 1 Q and A responses. The Naval Education and Training Security Assistance Field Activity (NETSAFA), Pensacola, Florida, requires educational and training services, engineering and technical services, logistics, administration, management assistance, consulting and facilitation services, and transportation support services, training liaison, special mission personnel, and curriculum development. These services may be required in various locations in the U.S. or in foreign countries and may include support to foreign governments with formal and informal schools and courses, Mobile Training Teams (MTTs), and Mobile Education Teams (METs) under the auspices of the Security Cooperation Education Training Program (SCETP)/Security Assistance Training Program (SATP). The PSC code for this action is U099 Education/Training-Other associated with NAICS code 541330 under the Knowledge Based Services Taxonomy of services. NETSAFA supports international training in all warfare areas and at all levels of training for foreign countries. This is accomplished by staffing, operating, and managing international training support provided at NETSAFAs international training sites. The training sites are located in the NETASAFA International Training Center (NITC) located at Naval Air Station (NAS) Pensacola, Florida and NAS Whiting Field, Milton, Florida, and NITC Detachment Whiting Field, Milton, Florida. These sites are outfitted with computer training facilities, classrooms, and equipment needed to teach courses. They provide training and training support services in Navy activities such as government-owned contractor operating facilities. NETSAFAs international training sites are currently operational and have established curriculum. The training and other services required by this Performance Work Statement (PWS) are currently centered in four categories: General Training Programs, Aviation Training Programs, Mobile Training Teams (MTTs), and Mobile Education Teams (METs). Additionally, support will be required to meet emerging requirements in support of the SCETP/SATP. The instant requirement is for services associated with the international requirement of the United States and the foreign countries participating in the SCETP/SATP for a 12-month base period of performance beginning 01 March 2027 through 29 February 2028, with three (3) consecutive 12-month option periods pursuant to FAR 52.217-9, and a 6-month option period pursuant to FAR 52.217-8. The contractor will be required to periodically perform these services in various locations in the U.S. and may be required to perform these services in foreign countries. If support is needed in a foreign country, the contractor may be required to support foreign governments with formal and informal schools and courses, mobile training teams, and mobile education teams under the auspices of the Security Cooperation Education Training Program (SCETP) /Security Assistance Training Program (SATP).
